issues.description: origin_port or destination_port is not a known port code (sentinel/placeholder values such as ZZZZZ, XXTST, UNKNW found).
issues.recommended_action: Quarantine -- cannot compute route stats without a valid origin/destination. Excluded from the curated layer.

issues.description: actual_arrival is null for a shipment whose status is DELIVERED/DELAYED (i.e. not cancelled), which is contradictory.
issues.recommended_action: Flag as data-integrity conflict; exclude from on-time/delay aggregates until resolved, but keep the row (it is still a real booking).

issues.description: shipment_id appears more than once. Some are exact duplicate rows (safe to drop); others have the same id with conflicting values (e.g. different weight_tons), which indicates a re-booking or upstream key collision.
issues.recommended_action: Drop exact duplicate rows. For id collisions with conflicting values, quarantine both rows for manual review rather than guessing which is correct.

issues.description: weight_tons is negative, which is physically impossible.
issues.recommended_action: Fix: take absolute value (most likely a sign-flip bug upstream) and flag the row as corrected.

issues.description: container_count is 0, which is not a valid booking.
issues.recommended_action: Quarantine for manual review; excluded from curated layer.

issues.description: cargo_type has casing/whitespace variants of the same value (e.g. 'FURNITURE', 'electronics', ' Chemicals') that should collapse to one canonical label.
issues.recommended_action: Fix: normalise to Title Case canonical set at ingestion time.

issues.description: status uses non-canonical labels/casing: 'COMPLETED', 'Complete', 'delivered' instead of the canonical DELIVERED/DELAYED/CANCELLED.
issues.recommended_action: Fix: map COMPLETED/Complete -> DELIVERED, uppercase everything, done once in the curated layer.
Flag + derive: infer DELIVERED/DELAYED from actual_arrival vs planned_arrival when dates are present, else quarantine.

issues.description: container_count > 500, far outside the observed distribution (median ~21, p99 ~70).
issues.recommended_action: Flag as statistical outlier; keep the row but exclude from features that are sensitive to scale until reviewed.

issues.description: Fully identical rows (every column matches another row).
Port reference rows with a null country field.
issues.recommended_action: Flag and backfill manually -- reference data is small enough to fix by hand. Does not block ingestion since country is not used in any derived calculation yet.
Flag; impute with per-cargo-type median in the curated layer.
Fix: impute as 'Unknown'. Not used as a leakage-risk field.
